sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT id, name FROM s.t) SELECT * FROM cte
WITH a AS (SELECT id FROM s.t WHERE val > 0), b AS (SELECT id FROM s.t2 WHERE amount > 0) SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id
note: multiple CTEs in one WITH clause

sql: WITH RECURSIVE counter(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM counter WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM counter
note: RECURSIVE CTE with UNION ALL anchor and recursive step

sql: WITH cte(a, b) AS (SELECT id, name FROM s.t) SELECT a, b FROM cte
note: CTE with explicit column alias list

sql: WITH cte AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, name FROM s.t) SELECT * FROM cte
note: MATERIALIZED hint forces CTE to be evaluated once

sql: WITH cte AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, name FROM s.t) SELECT * FROM cte
note: NOT MATERIALIZED hint allows CTE to be inlined

sql: WITH RECURSIVE search_tree(id, path) AS (SELECT id, ARRAY[id] FROM s.t WHERE id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT t.id, path || t.id FROM s.t t JOIN search_tree st ON t.id = st.id + 1 WHERE array_length(path, 1) < 3) SEARCH BREADTH FIRST BY id SET ordercol SELECT * FROM search_tree
note: SEARCH BREADTH FIRST BY ... SET clause on recursive CTE

sql: WITH RECURSIVE search_tree(id, path) AS (SELECT id, ARRAY[id] FROM s.t WHERE id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT t.id, path || t.id FROM s.t t JOIN search_tree st ON t.id = st.id + 1 WHERE array_length(path, 1) < 3) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY id SET ordercol SELECT * FROM search_tree
note: SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY ... SET clause on recursive CTE

sql: WITH RECURSIVE counter(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM counter WHERE n < 10) CYCLE n SET is_cycle USING path SELECT * FROM counter
note: CYCLE ... SET ... USING on recursive CTE (default TO/DEFAULT)

note: data-modifying CTE: INSERT ... RETURNING fed into outer SELECT
